record.body:
## Description

Declare contracted suite policy on the project design and pin this repo to full+advisory.

## Approach

1. Add top-level phase_gate.suite to contract/project-design.json with mode, command, gate.
2. Bundled default: mode=none, command empty, gate=required.
3. This repo: mode=full, gate=advisory, command=README full chain.
4. Sync .artifacts/project-design.json, resolve, pin digest.
5. Add test_contract_self_consistency coverage for phase_gate (-k phase_gate).
record.subject: phase-gate-contract
